title: Fetch, Read, Reuse: How AI Search Agents Bend the Web's Rules
abstract: arXiv:2611.30546v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI search agents form a new and fast-growing class of web traffic. Like a browser, they fetch pages on demand for one user; like a transcoding proxy, they rewrite what they fetch; and like a shared cache, they answer other users' questions from the stored copy. The rules publishers rely on, such as robots.txt, Retry-After, and Cache-Control, were written for more familiar clients, so the agent's vendor decides which of them to follow. We present a black-box measurement study of how these agents fetch, read, and reuse pages, covering the search APIs of OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and Google and the consumer apps of ten services. We find that OpenAI and xAI do not honor robots.txt, and no service acts on Retry-After. Services silently read less than the origin served: OpenAI drops some formats, no service reads JavaScript-only content, and xAI reads only the first 0.5 MB of a page. OpenAI, Anthropic, and xAI share fetched pages across users

translated_title: 获取、阅读、复用：AI搜索智能体如何扭曲万维网的规则
translated_abstract: AI搜索智能体构成了一类新兴且快速增长的网络流量。它们像浏览器一样按需为单个用户抓取页面；像转码代理一样重写所抓取的内容；又像共享缓存一样，利用存储的副本回答其他用户的问题。网站发布者所依赖的规则，例如robots.txt、Retry-After和Cache-Control，原本是为更常见的客户端编写的，因此由智能体的供应商自行决定遵循其中哪些规则。我们对这些智能体如何抓取、阅读和复用页面进行了一项黑盒测量研究，涵盖了OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI和Google的搜索API以及十项服务的消费级应用。我们发现OpenAI和xAI不遵守robots.txt，且没有任何服务会对Retry-After做出响应。各服务暗中读取的内容少于源站所提供的内容：OpenAI会丢弃某些格式，没有服务能读取仅由JavaScript呈现的内容，而xAI只读取页面的前0.5 MB。OpenAI、Anthropic和xAI还会在用户之间共享已抓取的页面。
tldr: 该论文通过黑盒测量研究发现，主流AI搜索智能体普遍不遵守robots.txt和Retry-After等网站规则，暗中减少读取的内容并在用户之间共享抓取的页面，偏离了网站发布者所依赖的Web规范。
en_tdlr: This black-box measurement study reveals that mainstream AI search agents routinely violate web publishers' rules such as robots.txt and Retry-After, silently read less content than served, and share fetched pages across users.
